movelist.name: Draining Kiss
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Growth
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage. If it is Sunny, double the amount of Combat Stages gained.

movelist.name: Flower Shield
movelist.effect: All Grass Type Pokémon in Flower Shield’s area of effect have their Defense raised by +2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Sweet Kiss
movelist.effect: The target becomes Confused. On miss, the target suffers a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for one full round.

movelist.name: Helping Hand
movelist.effect: Helping Hand grants the target +2 on their next Accuracy Roll this round, and +10 to the next Damage Roll this round.

abilities.name: Flower Veil
abilities.effect: Grass-Type Pokemon within 5 meters cannot have their Combat Stages lowered.

abilities.name: Flower Power
abilities.effect: The user may perform damaging Grass Type Moves as if they were their choice of either Physical or Special.
